summary: Browse and read books from your calibre-web library. Needs an account.
page_description: Browse a public or private OPDS library, download EPUBs and continue reading offline. Library is an unofficial OPDS client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the calibre-web or calibre projects.
release_notes: Shows a full screen of books at a time, says Sign in again when the library refuses your account, and tells you when the library at home cannot be reached instead of blaming the address. Reopens a document on the page you left.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already. The library must be reachable over HTTPS.
Connect your library from your computer. It asks for the OPDS address, your username and password, checks them, and sets Library up. Open Library, or tap Check again.
Or add the HTTPS OPDS address on the reader and choose Sign in, or Use public library for a library without an account.
For a private certificate authority, install its trust root on the reader. Pass the same file to kobo connect with --ca.
